articles.title: Mother of trooper killed in crash sues Saugus restaurant, alleging it over-served wrong-way driver
articles.description:
The lawsuit claims Tribu Mexican Kitchen & Bar served Hernan Ramon Marrero nine drinks, with some being free, even after he became visibly intoxicated.

The post Mother of trooper killed in crash sues Saugus restaurant, alleging it over-served wrong-way driver appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Mother of fallen trooper sues Tribu Mexican Kitchen for over-serving the wrong-way driver.
Lawsuit claims the restaurant served Hernan Ramon Marrero nine drinks, some of which were free.
The case highlights concerns over alcohol service and public safety in Saugus, impacting local establishments.
